title: SREV-076 GUI console thread handoff contract

parent_handles.description: Parent-owned ready event and helper thread handles used for startup wait

worker_handles.description: Worker-owned main-thread wait handle used after startup

contracts: allocated handle context exists before any handle slot write
OpenThread, CreateEvent, and CreateThread failure paths do not publish partial ownership
parent startup wait uses parent-owned ready-event and helper-thread handles
worker owns the main-thread wait handle after successful CreateThread handoff
parent must not close a handle while the worker can still wait on it
worker early exits and normal exit close the main-thread handle and free the context
